claims.text: The preserved DeepSeek API change-log snapshot was inspected for March 2026 entries, but no concrete March-dated model or API item was exposed in the retained HTML evidence.
claims.context: Finding is limited to the preserved August 12 snapshot collected by Source Intake; it is not a claim that DeepSeek made no March changes.

limitations.text: Absence from the retained snapshot is not evidence of absence in March. A separate immutable first-party March source would be required before promoting a concrete DeepSeek item.

targets.target: extract March-dated model, API, agent, multimodal, open-weight, and lifecycle items
targets.finding: No concrete March 2026 item was recoverable from the preserved DeepSeek API change-log snapshot.

unresolved_questions: Can an immutable first-party DeepSeek source establish a March 2026 model/API change without relying on current-memory reconstruction or secondary reporting?

editorial.why_now_note: DeepSeek is strategically relevant, but the preserved canonical snapshot does not expose a concrete March item that meets the Evidence threshold.
editorial.rationale: Keep as an explicit Evidence gap rather than inventing or backfilling an unpreserved March event.
